why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P1 shell-1.3): `InnerNav` bound to a `defineControls` push field draws dead links. It spreads `state.link(value)` onto `<a>` and expects `{ href, onClick }` (`src/page/parts/inner-nav.tsx:21,129`); a field's `link()` returns TanStack link options `{ search, replace, resetScroll }` (`src/router/controls/define.ts:87,108`), so every item is an anchor with no `href`: no focus, no click, no copy-link. The field's `history` is typed `'push' | 'replace'` (`define.ts:102`), so tsc also refuses it as a `PushField`. Every app with a settings page or a record list repeats the 50-line adapter in `apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-1/handle-adapters.ts`; `routes/settings.tsx` hand-builds a whole handle for the same reason.
what: `InnerNav` takes a `defineControls` push field as it is, and draws real links.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/router/controls/define.ts (the handle's `history` type) and its type-guard tests
apps/playground/src/routes/settings.tsx (drop the hand-built handle for a `defineControls` field)
change: A field declared with `{ history: 'push' }` types its handle's `history` as `'push'`, so it is a `PushField` without a cast. `InnerNav` turns the field's `link(value)` into an anchor: the `href` from the router's `buildLocation` with the field's search patch, a plain left click that writes the field (modified clicks left to the browser), `aria-current` on the active item. The structural `{ href, onClick }` handle keeps working. `routes/settings.tsx` binds a `defineControls` field. The PR names the `cycle-shell-1: shell-1.3` workarounds it makes removable; the cycle build is not edited.
commits: fix: one commit in packages/basalt-ui; the playground route in its own commit.
proof: make check; a router test and a type-guard test.
acceptance: `<InnerNav state={store.field.section} …>` with `field.enum(…, { history: 'push' })` type-checks with no cast (type-guard test)
Under a router each item is an `<a href>` carrying the field's param, and a click pushes it; Back returns (router test)
